protocol.memory: reject estimates above min(50% currently free RAM, 25% total RAM); 128 MiB AES retained-output cap
protocol.latency: closed-loop job latency; batching counts operations separately
protocol.queueQuantiles: unavailable: public PJS statistics provide means only
protocol.memoryScope: RSS process-wide; heap/external/arrayBuffers main isolate only; 10 ms sampled peak is a lower bound
protocol.transfer: input ownership moves to worker and back on every job; input allocation outside timing
protocol.aes: encryption and ciphertext+tag return timed; decrypt and tamper checks outside timing
